title: [epic] Azure Blob Storage block store backend
description:
## Why
Azure Blob Storage is the dominant object store in enterprise and Microsoft-aligned deployments. Unlike S3-compatible stores, Azure has its own native API; using it natively avoids the S3-compatibility shim and gives access to Azure-specific features (lifecycle policies, immutability, private endpoints).

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "azure"` config: storage account, container name, credential (connection string or managed identity)
- `AzureStore: IpfsStore` backed by `azure_storage_blobs` crate (or `object_store` Azure provider)
- Blob name = CID base32; content-type = `application/octet-stream`
- Startup: verify container reachable and writable
- Integration test against Azurite (Azure Storage emulator) via docker-compose
- RUNBOOK section
